name: Amp lets teams self-host orbs, its agent sandboxes, on their own infrastructure
title: Amp lets teams self-host orbs, its agent sandboxes, on their own infrastructure
summary: Amp's coding-agent machines (orbs) can now run on your own compute: you run an orb provider that dispatches spawn, pause and delete requests to your own script, with examples for Docker, Kubernetes, E2B, Modal, Daytona and Apple containers. Free for individuals and teams.
